title: The Crab Derby, 2012
logline: Twenty-eighth annual. Wood letters it at 4 AM at the motel desk on Gully's flyer; Gully picks it up at six on the way to bait. The girl, two, has drawn on it already.

panels.composition: The desk, 4 AM. WOOD lettering the flyer. A toddler's crayon loops already on it. The hum line.

image.prompt: a motel night clerk lettering a crab-derby flyer that already has a toddler's crayon loops on it, 4 AM lamp light, razor-sharp ink, a flat unbroken line running beneath the panel

panels.composition: The flyer. 28TH ANNUAL CRAB DERBY in the display face, lettered around the loops. He works with them.

image.prompt: close-up of bold hand-lettering worked carefully around a toddler's crayon scribbles on a paper flyer

panels.composition: 6 AM. GULLY at the glass door in the canvas jacket, not coming in. Wood handing the flyer through.

image.prompt: a stocky man in a canvas jacket at a motel's glass door at dawn taking a flyer from a clerk through the doorway, a flat unbroken line running beneath the panel

panels.composition: Gully's flatbed pulling out into the gray. Wood at the door. The flyer, later, on the shack wall — the crayon loops the only color the strip allows this year.

image.prompt: a flatbed truck pulling out of a motel lot at gray dawn seen from a clerk at the glass door, an inset of a lettered flyer with crayon loops pinned to a shingle wall, no words
image.notes: The loops in crayon color; everything else ink. One spot of tone.

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: Lettered around the toddler's loops. 'In the flyer.'
